name: The Ralph Loop: How Recursive AI Agents Actually Work
snippet: In this article I'll walk you through what a Ralph loop is, how it works, how to actually run one in Claude Code or Codex, and (the part I find most fascinating) what you can read in its journal in the morning. I'll also be honest about where it falls over and where it's the wrong tool entirely.

name: GitHub - vercel-labs/ralph-loop-agent: Continuous Autonomy
snippet: What is the Ralph Wiggum Technique? The Ralph Wiggum technique is a development methodology built around continuous AI agent loops. At its core, it's elegantly simple: keep feeding an AI agent a task until the job is done. As Geoffrey Huntley describes it: "Ralph is a Bash loop."

name: The Ralph Loop: How I Run Autonomous AI Agents Overnight
snippet: I built an autonomous agent system with stop hooks, spawn budgets, and filesystem memory. Here are the failures and what actually ships code.

name: The Ralph Loop: Long-Running AI Agents | ZeroSync Blog
snippet: The Ralph Loop (also known as the "Ralph Wiggum technique") is an AI agent orchestration method for reliable, long-running autonomous coding tasks. Named after the endearingly simple-minded character from The Simpsons, the technique embraces limitations rather than fighting them.

name: The Ralph Loop: The loop that fixes AI Agents Memory problem
snippet: The Ralph Loop (also called the Ralph Wiggum Technique) is a methodology for running AI agents in continuous, self-correcting loops until a task is fully complete. It was popularized by developer Geoffrey Huntley in 2024–2025 and is now widely used with autonomous coding agents like Claude Code.

name: Ralph Loop – Claude Plugin | Anthropic
snippet: Ralph Loop enables iterative, self-referential AI development loops where Claude works on the same task repeatedly until completion. The plugin intercepts session exits via a stop hook and automatically re-feeds your prompt while preserving all file modifications and git history between iterations.

name: Ralph Wiggum Loop: Autonomous Iteration Workflows | The AI
snippet: What is Ralph Wiggum Loop? Definition: Ralph Wiggum Loop is a Claude Code plugin that enables autonomous iteration:Claude Code runs a task, checks the result, identifies what needs fixing, makes corrections, and repeats until a completion condition is met, all without your intervention.
